resource_amendment.reason: The 512-point copula pilot projects about 10400 seconds for four chains at the unchanged 500 warmup and 800 retained settings. Before control production or scientific scores, increase the per-fit cap symmetrically for copula and both GP resolutions to four hours. The three control fits and their checks together have a five-hour cap. Keep the twelve-hour study cap, single CPU thread and 2 GiB memory limit. Charge 5.5 hours for inherited costs, exceeding the approximately 4.7 hours of recorded external calculations and reused selected/LISA posteriors; this leaves at least 1.5 hours for later work even if the whole new allocation is spent. Incomplete fits remain inconclusive.

decision: Four sequential chains per model with the original protocol's seeds, warmup, retained draws, acceptance and depth. Initialize from training observations only, using dispersed GP hyperparameters and independent event-clustering initializations for copula. Preserve all attempts. Copula uses the checked 512-point Sobol target, correction to the independent 2048-point Sobol likelihood, and checks against the archived 8192 IID cloud. Require original mixing thresholds, zero divergences, numerical accuracy and correlated correction precision before scientific use. No test measurements or truth enter this calculation.
